newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin price up on LME despite high ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin price up on LME despite high ringgit.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose eight cents to 14.43 ringgit ($5.82) a kg due to an overnight surge on the London Metal Exchange (LME) which helped override concerns over a strong Malaysian ringgit.
"The domestic market followed the LME. Otherwise, we might have seen a further fall today due to the ringgit," said a trader.
Bids totalled 169 tonnes against offers of 96. Buyers were Europeans and locals. Turnover rose to 121 tonnes from 96. The local premium against London fell to $25 from $110.
